pathBase: Repository root; every entry is a local relative path.
scope: Fixed snapshot of task-generated retained evidence present under .artifacts and docs/evidence at the cutoff. Includes historical failures, successful runs, diagnostics, test-generated checkpoint saves, scripts, original recordings and extracted review stills. Hashes identify bytes; this inventory does not certify a test pass, visual quality, the currently served build or release acceptance.
coverage: Only the enumerated regular files are covered. Files created or modified after the cutoff, currently active native-input-focused output and excluded private/cache/dependency paths are not covered. Later runs or edits require a new snapshot; this is not an all-future-artifact claim.

active_native_input.scope: Explicitly excluded active log, JSON, output directory and nested recordings/traces.

browser_profile_or_cache.rule: Browser profiles, browser IPC/shared-memory names, Node compile cache, Playwright transform cache, node_modules and temporary dependency bundles.
browser_profile_or_cache.scope: No profile contents, cookies, cache records, sockets or dependency copies are inventoried.

not_retained_evidence_type.rule: Files outside the retained log/report/script/media/trace extensions; extensionless test stubs are allowed only under .artifacts/tmp/ci-xvfb-review/bin/.
not_retained_evidence_type.scope: Excludes downloaded upstream C++/YAML source copies and non-evidence binary/temp files.

not_regular_file.rule: Symbolic links and all non-regular file types.

modified_after_cutoff.rule: mtime later than snapshot cutoff, including files changed during enumeration.
modified_after_cutoff.scope: New or ongoing probes are outside this fixed snapshot.

changed_during_hash.rule: Identity, size, mtime or ctime changed between enumeration and completed hashing.
changed_during_hash.scope: An unstable file cannot receive a snapshot hash.

inventory_itself.scope: Excluded to avoid a self-referential checksum.
